newsitem.title: GREECE: DEP TO RISE PETROL PRICES ON DECEMBER 28.
newsitem.headline: DEP TO RISE PETROL PRICES ON DECEMBER 28.

text.p: The Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) will rise its prices on Saturday, after an increase in petrol prices internationally and because of the rise in the dollar/drachma rate, it said in a statement.

The new prices will be raised by 1.9 drs per litter for gasoline, 1.3 drs per litter for diesel and 1.3 drs per litter for heating petrol, compared to last week's prices. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
